_comment: Recommended Claude Code settings for Business Operating System users. Drop into ~/.claude/settings.json (Mac/Linux) or %USERPROFILE%\.claude\settings.json (Windows). Read-only TrustPager tools are pre-allowed so you don't get prompted for every list/get/search. Write tools (send, create, update, delete) still prompt — that's intentional.
_send_and_write_note: Anything not in 'allow' or 'deny' prompts each time. That means send_email, send_sms, create_*, update_*, bulk_*, trigger_*, dispatch_*, and execute_* all surface a confirmation step. Recommended — don't remove that. If you want a specific write tool pre-allowed (e.g. you trust /log-this-call to add notes without asking), add it explicitly here.

env._: Add any environment variables your skills need. Most won't need anything beyond the MCP connection.
